text:
Carla (Auditor): Quick ask: we need an evidence package for the SA named `infra-backfill-sa` that was removed on 2025-08-12. Auditor wants a clear chain: deprovision event, credential revocation, KMS grant revocation or key rotation, and any linked incident/vuln records. Need exportable artifacts, checksums, and a signed manifest. Deadline next Tue EOD.

Alice (Security): Understood. We'll compile CloudTrail + K8s audit slice + IAM change record.

Ben (Platform): Proposed artifact list: 1) CloudTrail JSON filtered by principal 2) K8s audit logs for namespace infra 3) IAM change (git commit + PR link) 4) KMS events + describe-key output 5) Deprovision job logs. I'll stage to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1769998888/.

Evan (SRE): Deprovision job id run-20250812-09f3, logs uploaded. Devops bot: run-20250812-09f3 completed (exit=0).

Alice (Security): Commands we'll run so it's reproducible: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=infra-backfill-sa --start-time 2025-08-12T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-08-13T00:00:00Z` and `kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector --since=48h | grep infra-backfill-sa -A5 -B2`.

Ben (Platform): For KMS: include CloudTrail ReEncrypt/DisableKey events and `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood/prod/infra-backfill`. We'll also export any KMS grants list where granteePrincipal matches the SA.

Fiona (Compliance PM): I'll assemble the manifest JSON with object list + sha256 sums and sign it with my GPG key. Manifest will indicate collected_by and collection_method (cli/manual/automated).

Carla (Auditor): Please ensure manifest rows include: artifact origin (CLI vs job), UTC collected_at, who approved the deprovision, and any redactions noted. Also need mapping showing when all active creds for the SA were removed.

Alice (Security): We'll add a CSV mapping resource,event_ts,event_id,artifact_path. Example: `access-key,2025-08-12T09:02:11Z,evt-01,s3://...`

Evan (SRE): Linking incident: the SA appears in INC-2025-324 (vuln triage). I'll export the ticket PDF and annotate timestamps.

Ben (Platform): Example manifest entry we'll produce: `{ path: "s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1769998888/cloudtrail-infra-backfill.json.gz", sha256: "b7f8d...", collected_by: "alice@redwood.com", collected_at: "2025-08-12T13:12:00Z", source: "cloudtrail" }`.

Fiona (Compliance PM): I'll publish manifest at s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1769998888/manifest.json and signature at manifest.json.asc. Will also email public key to the auditor contact.

Carla (Auditor): Good. Also need explicit proof that any KMS grants referencing `infra-backfill-sa` were revoked or rekeyed. Signed attestations are OK.

Alice (Security): We'll include key metadata snapshot and CloudTrail statements showing GrantRevoke or DisableKey. We'll add a short attestation PDF signed by the Security Lead.

devops-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1769998888/evidence-bundle-20250818.zip (sha256: c4d2e...). Manifest signed and uploaded.

Fiona (Compliance PM): Sent signed manifest and public key to carla@example-audit.com.

Carla (Auditor): Received, reviewing. If I need follow-ups I'll reopen here. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
